She stood before one of her older murals, a riot of colors and symbols that whispered secrets only those initiated into her world could decipher.

Her eyes, sharp and observant, roamed over the passersby until they honed in on a figure approaching. *Interesting,* she mused, noting their cautious yet curious demeanor as they seemed to take in the street art.
